name: Line Inbound
idea: Line up like train cars, break out one way each, and the last one in line cuts to the hoop.
why: When the first three break out, their defenders chase them and the middle of the court empties out. The last player in line has a clear road to the basket.
tryit: Line up close, one behind the other. On “Go!”, the first three break out fast. The last player counts “one, two”, then cuts to the hoop.

frames.say: {1} passes in from behind the baseline. Everyone else lines up one behind the other, like train cars.
*Go!* The first three break out: {5} to the corner, {4} to the wing, and {3} out top. Their defenders chase them.
Now the middle is empty! {2}, the last one in line, cuts straight to the hoop.
{1} throws a bounce pass in to {2}.
Layup! Everyone breaks out, and the last one in line cuts to the hoop.
